findings.title: Disabled organizations can mask login-eligibility changes
findings.body: `original` comes from `getById()`, which wraps organization-linked providers so `isEnabled()` is also false when their organization is disabled; `updated` is typically an unwrapped model. If the organization is disabled, changing an otherwise enabled provider from visible to `hideOnLogin=true` can make both predicates false and take this early return, leaving the cached login query unchanged. When the organization is later enabled, the stale cached ID can expose the hidden provider on the login page. Changes that make a provider newly eligible can likewise be missed, leaving it absent from the cache.
